items.title: The Ultimate Bull Case for NVIDIA Is Here: Their Powerful B200 Systems Are Sold Out
items.summary: NVIDIA just delivered its loudest quarter of the AI era, yet shares sit nearly 30% below their peak while B200 systems vanish from shelves faster than they ship. The bull case for a run to $300 hinges on three things that still need to break right.

items.title: Amazon’s AWS CEO Just Sent Shivers Down the Spines of AI Bears. Supply is Mostly ‘Spoken For’ Through 2028.
items.summary: AWS chief Matt Garman just posted something on X that stopped AI skeptics cold, and the suppliers quietly sitting on his order books are already feeling it in their stock prices.

items.title: Semiconductor Rally Powers S&P 500 to Fresh Record High
items.summary: MRVL, AMD and MU rallied as AI optimism, earnings anticipation and strong memory demand powered a semiconductor surge that helped lift the S&P 500 to a record high.

items.title: AI and Chip Stocks Drop After Musk's Nvidia Bombshell
items.summary: Investors were once again trying to make sense of comments from Elon Musk on Wednesday, after the SpaceX CEO said his rocket and AI company would exclusively use Nvidia chips from now on.  AMD was the S&P 500's worst performer ahead of the opening bell, slumping 8.7% as Musk's announcement overshadowed a second-quarter earnings beat.  Nvidia's own shares climbed 2%.
